description:
Execute the frozen ISA-L comparison against equivalent gf2 XOR cells and publish both isolated and adapter-inclusive observations.

## Background

The dispatched ISA-L route is used only when the qualified build has NASM and exposes the public SIMD path. Otherwise the receipt labels `xor_gen_base` as a scalar base arm and preserves dispatched-route unavailability. No external arm is called a competitive baseline without measured compatibility.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The receipt contains raw samples, exact external build and run commands, content-pinned inputs, runtime selected-symbol evidence, statistical interpretation, and all setup, adapter, conversion, and output costs.
- [hard] REQ-02: Semantically equivalent output is demonstrated for the frozen aligned, offset, and boundary cells, with isolated throughput reported separately from consumer relevance.
- [hard] REQ-03: Losing, inconclusive, base-only, or unavailable cells remain in the committed evidence without triggering production adoption.
- [hard] REQ-04: The ISA-L probe and arm builds record compiler identity and build-time provenance before any measurement: the resolved compiler path and version, `MAKEFLAGS`, `GNUMAKEFLAGS`, `MFLAGS` and `MAKEFILES` cleared, the verbose build transcript, and the `.comment` section of every produced object, following the M4RI pins in `survey/m4ri-build-pins.sh` and `survey/check-m4ri-build-provenance.sh`; the bare `cc` in `survey/run-isal-xor-probe.sh` is replaced by the resolved compiler and the qualification record is regenerated with it.

## Notes

Run only in the benchmark window on the prepared host under the full-host wrapper.

Invoker ruling 2026-09-16 (execution-lead escalation): the ISA-L compiler-provenance repair belongs to this task rather than a separate one; REQ-04 records it.
title: Measure the ISA-L XOR comparison
